item.title: Grief Poem - Season Of Grief
item.description: A neighbor called, said two guys left, their families are so sad. They weren't that old their kinfolk said, they're missed, families feel bad. item.title: Havre Contractor named to state construction association board
item.description: Press release The Montana Contractors Association announced that Tyler Smith of Lakeside Excavation has been elected to serve as its Board Treasurer for 2026. Smith is the owner Lakeside Excavation in Havre.
